function.name: instance_terminate
function.description: Terminate an instance (audited, gated, dry-run default).

id.description: Target instance id (short form accepted). Required. Acting on your own session is refused.

cascade.description: True (default) terminates the target AND its whole cascade tree (the underlying service is total). False means 'the target only, descendants stay running' — that CREATES orphans, so it REFUSES with reason=cascade-false-would-orphan-descendants unless allow_orphan_descendants=True acknowledges it.

reason.description: REQUIRED, free text, stored verbatim in the audit ledger. The health report's evidence feeds this.

dry_run.description: True (default) — the preview lists the target, the full cascade tree, the protected determination, the confirmation requirement, the budget state and the orphan list, and mutates NOTHING. False applies the terminate (audited, Tier-1 same-transaction).

confirmed_target_id.description: The named-target confirmation for a PROTECTED target (D-17): must equal `id` VERBATIM. Anything else is refused. Attributable and audited — the ledger records it next to the provenance fields.

allow_orphan_descendants.description: Explicit acknowledgement for cascade=False on a target with live descendants. When True the preview AND the audit row NAME the descendants that will be orphaned.

function.name: instance_reclaim
function.description: Revive a TERMINAL instance with a documented message (audited).

id.description: Target instance id (short form accepted). Required.

message.description: REQUIRED — the revival message delivered to the revived instance. The message itself IS the revival record: it lands in the revived instance's checkpoint and is the durable evidence of what was revived and why.

reason.description: REQUIRED free text; stored verbatim in the ledger.

dry_run.description: True (default) — the preview shows the target's terminal status and the message; no mutation. False revives the target by documented message (audited, Tier-2 write-ahead).

function.name: instance_nudge
function.description: Inject a message into any instance (audited).

id.description: Target instance id (short form accepted). Required.

message.description: REQUIRED — the message to inject. Delivered into the target's live turn when one is running, otherwise durably enqueued.

reason.description: REQUIRED free text; stored verbatim in the ledger.

dry_run.description: True (default) — preview only. Note: a nudge to a TERMINAL instance REVIVES it (revive-on-send); the preview names that when the target is terminal.

function.name: instance_mark
function.description: Write a park / protect / suspect marker (audited).

id.description: Target instance id (short form accepted). Required.

marker.description: One of 'park' | 'protect' | 'suspect'. park writes the deliberate-pause tombstone (the release path defers to it); protect adds the dynamic protection layer (idempotent refusal on a repeat); suspect is a non-blocking annotation. Anything else is refused with reason=invalid-marker. There is NO unprotect.

note.description: Optional free-text annotation stored with the marker.

reason.description: REQUIRED free text; stored verbatim in the ledger.

dry_run.description: True (default) — preview only. False writes the marker (audited: protect/suspect are Tier-1 same-transaction; park is Tier-2 write-ahead).

function.name: instance_answer
function.description: Answer a pending question pack and resume the cascade (audited).

id.description: The ASKER instance id (short form accepted). Required.

answers.description: The answer payload as a DICT (the route schema is answers: dict — NOT a list). Passed verbatim to the same implementation the HTTP route uses.

question_pack_id.description: Optional pack id echo for correlation; a mismatch refuses with reason=stale-question-pack.

reason.description: REQUIRED free text; stored verbatim in the ledger.

dry_run.description: True (default) — preview only. False submits the answer and resumes the cascade (audited, Tier-2 write-ahead).

function.name: instance_dismiss
function.description: Dismiss a pending question pack without answering (audited).

id.description: The ASKER instance id (short form accepted). Required.

reason.description: REQUIRED free text; stored verbatim in the ledger.

dry_run.description: True (default) — preview only. False dismisses the pack and resumes the cascade (audited, Tier-2 write-ahead).

function.name: instance_list
function.description: Fleet census — one cheap row per instance. Use tool_help("instance_list") for details.

status.description: Exact instance status to filter on, applied in SQL: idle | running | waiting | paused | completed | error | terminated | queued | waiting_children | failed. Omit for all statuses. Any other value is refused with reason=unknown-status-value.

limit.description: Max rows to return (1-200, default 50). Out-of-range values are refused with reason=invalid-limit.

offset.description: Rows to skip (SQL offset). A negative value is clamped to 0 and the clamp is reported in filters_applied.

function.name: instance_get
function.description: Deep detail for ONE instance (hydration). Use tool_help("instance_get") for details.

id.description: Instance id (short form accepted — typos are resolved by fuzzy match). Required.

function.name: instance_health
function.description: Wedge report — eight read-only detectors. Use tool_help("instance_health") for details.

stale_minutes.description: Staleness threshold in minutes (>= 1, default 30). A non-positive value is refused with reason=invalid-stale-minutes.

function.name: fleet_capacity_summary
function.description: How's the nest — counts, queue depth, pool, DLQ. Use tool_help("fleet_capacity_summary") for details.

function.name: instance_fleet_summary
function.description: Alias of fleet_capacity_summary — same payload. Use tool_help("fleet_capacity_summary") for details.

function.name: wedge_capture_list
function.description: Recent wedge captures — one row per capture. Use tool_help("wedge_capture_list") for details.

function.name: wedge_capture_get
function.description: One wedge capture's full payload — manifest + every artifact. Use tool_help("wedge_capture_get") for details.

capture_id.description: The capture id — the capture directory's name (<UTC-ts>-<host>-<reason>-<uuid8>).

function.name: notify_user
function.description: Send ONE message to this session's registered chat source. Use tool_help("notify_user") for details.

message.description: The message text, 1-2000 chars (one notify = one chat message; over-length is refused BEFORE any resolution or dispatch). Plain text — no attachments, no markdown tables.

function.name: self_alarm
function.description: Arm a self-directed alarm (>= 30 minutes out). Use tool_help("self_alarm") for details.

label.description: Short human name for the alarm (1-115 chars). Stored as 'self-alarm:<label>' — do NOT include the prefix.

when_or_every.description: When the alarm fires: an absolute ISO-8601 instant ('2026-10-20T09:00:00+07:00'), a relative duration ('45m', 'in 2h', '1d30m'), 'daily 06:30', 'weekly 1 06:30' (0=Sunday..6=Saturday) or a raw cron expression ('cron 0 9 * * *'). At least 30 minutes out.

message_to_self.description: What YOU should do when the alarm fires (it fires into this same session). Appended verbatim as the message's Action line.

link_board_item.description: Optional board item id ('wi-1a2b3c4d') to link — when the alarm fires into THIS session you are told to board_get it before acting.
